metadata.description: Hub address from Instalily, as IP:port, e.g. 203.0.113.10:443.
Enrollment token from Instalily. It is valid for 24 hours by default; ask for a new one if it has expired.

Targets Instalily may reach, as JSON. Each entry is a "cidr" (a range or one IP) or a "host" (a name, or "*.corp.example" for any name under it), with "ports". Example: [{"cidr": "10.1.2.3", "ports": [1433]}]
Name of the existing virtual network for the VM. Its subnet must route to the targets and allow outbound HTTPS.
Resource group of the virtual network. Leave empty if it is this deployment's resource group.
Name of the subnet for the VM.
Name of the VM and the prefix of its disk, network interface and security group.
VM size. The connector needs little; Standard_B2s leaves headroom.
Region. Defaults to the resource group's.
Connector image, pinned by digest. Instalily sends a new one for each upgrade.
Leave as generated. Nobody needs it; see the template's comments.

variables.$fxv#0:
#cloud-config
# Turns a fresh Ubuntu 24.04 VM into an edge connector: installs Docker,
# writes the connector's files to /opt/edge-connector, starts it, and empties
# the enrollment token once the connector has enrolled.
#
# azuredeploy.bicep fills the three placeholders, each written as its name
# between double @ signs. To use this file elsewhere, replace them by hand:
#   IMAGE   the connector image, pinned by digest
#   CONFIG  the connector configuration, as one line of JSON
#   TOKEN   the enrollment token from Instalily
#
# The VM needs outbound HTTPS to the Ubuntu package mirrors, public.ecr.aws and
# the hub.

package_update: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - docker-compose-v2

write_files:
  - path: /opt/edge-connector/.env
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      EDGE_CONNECTOR_IMAGE=@@IMAGE@@
  - path: /opt/edge-connector/config.yaml
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      @@CONFIG@@
  # Only the container's user (UID 65532) may read the token; runcmd sets the
  # owner, because write_files runs before that user could be named.
  - path: /opt/edge-connector/token
    permissions: "0400"
    content: |
      @@TOKEN@@
  - path: /opt/edge-connector/docker-compose.yml
    permissions: "0644"
    content: |
      services:
        connector:
          image: ${EDGE_CONNECTOR_IMAGE:?set EDGE_CONNECTOR_IMAGE in .env}
          command: ["-config", "/etc/edge-connector/config.yaml"]
          restart: unless-stopped
          read_only: true
          cap_drop: [ALL]
          security_opt: ["no-new-privileges:true"]
          volumes:
            - ./config.yaml:/etc/edge-connector/config.yaml:ro
            - ./token:/etc/edge-connector/token:ro
            - state:/var/lib/edge-connector
          healthcheck:
            # Healthy while at least one tunnel to the hub is open.
            test: ["CMD", "/usr/local/bin/edge-connector", "-probe", "http://127.0.0.1:8080/readyz"]
            interval: 30s
          logging:
            driver: json-file
            options:
              max-size: 50m
              max-file: "5"
      volumes:
        state: {}
  - path: /usr/local/sbin/edge-connector-clear-token
    permissions: "0755"
    content: |
      #!/bin/sh
      # Empties the token once the connector has enrolled: its key and
      # certificate are then in the state volume, and it renews them itself.
      # The file stays, empty, because Docker would mount a directory in its
      # place if it were missing.
      cd /opt/edge-connector || exit 1
      i=0
      while [ "$i" -lt 360 ]; do
        if docker compose logs connector 2>/dev/null | grep -q '"msg":"enrolled"'; then
          truncate -s 0 token
          echo "connector enrolled; token emptied"
          exit 0
        fi
        i=$((i + 1))
        sleep 10
      done
      echo "connector did not enroll within an hour; see: docker compose logs connector" >&2
      exit 1

runcmd:
  - chown 65532:65532 /opt/edge-connector/token
  - systemctl enable --now docker
  - cd /opt/edge-connector && docker compose up -d
  # A transient unit, so cloud-init finishes without waiting for enrollment.
  - systemd-run --unit edge-connector-clear-token /usr/local/sbin/edge-connector-clear-token

properties.description: The connector accepts no connections; it only dials out.
